Senses.Explanation: Beichan's year-end rite names the exposed-white-ox feast. Baichi calls it self-entangling; Yuan'an compares it with his own provisions; Xingkong substitutes ginger broth; Huanxi says the ox was nearly set out in vain. Baichi Xingyuan supplies the critical recall deployment through direct criticism that Beichan's year-end provision entangled itself. Yuan'an Liao supplies the comparison with another provision deployment through direct comparison between Beichan slaughtering and his own reliance on the exposed white ox. Xingkong Xingzhen supplies the ginger-broth substitution and verse deployment through direct substitution of ginger broth followed by an original verse on Beichan. Huanxi Weiyi supplies the case appraisal deployment through direct case appraisal that Beichan's exposed white ox was nearly set out in vain.
